en.title: RMD Note Workflow
en.subtitle: A platform-agnostic Rmd writing workflow plugin
en.description: Orchestrates collaborative content creation across four concurrent phases: architecture, writing, review, and compilation.

features.qa_desc: RE:KCTSW narrative framework + structured FAIL thresholds
features.compilation_desc: Concurrent builds + automatic retry + format validation
features.dependencies_desc: Auto-detect and lock R, Python, and LaTeX environments

en.phase1_desc: Answers interactive prompts to auto-generate config.json and project structure.
